people.name: Elizabeth
people.line: The wife of Zechariah and mother of John the Baptist.

translations.web: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.
translations.bsb: When the time came for Elizabeth to have her child, she gave birth to a son.
translations.kjv: Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
translations.asv: Now Elisabeth's time was fulfilled that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son.
